Consent Form

Welcome to the Research Study!  
 
We are researchers at the University of Washington. In this study, we are interested in understanding more about people's opinions and reactions to information about health-related topics. In this survey, you will be asked questions about what you see that will help with our investigation. Please be assured that your responses will be kept completely confidential.   

The study should take you around 10 minutes to complete, and you will receive monetary compensation for your participation. Your participation in this research is voluntary. This means you can choose not to continue and you can click the do not consent button below. You also have the right to withdraw at any point during the study, for any reason, and without any prejudice by simply exiting the survey. If you would like to discuss this research and your participation, please contact the research team through the Prolific messaging system (which ensures the anonymity of your personal identity).  
 
By clicking the button below, you acknowledge that your participation in the study is voluntary, that you are 18 years of age, and that you are aware that you may choose to terminate your participation in the study at any time and for any reason. You agree to proceed and participate in the study.
